subject: Execution Manifest and Staged Onboarding (MAP) for PhoenixAI
messages:
From: Connor Ellis <connor@phoenixai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@phoenixai.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Execution manifesto & staged onboarding (MAP) — PhoenixAI

Alex —

Thanks again for a great close yesterday. As discussed, our IT and product teams want a single MAP that captures the post-signature execution: rollout phases, canary windows, migration cutover, and training cohorts. We sketched something during the call but we need a concrete, executable plan to share with our board and the audit team.

Top priorities for us:
- A two-week canary with rollback criteria and a smoke checklist
- Minimal user impact during data migration (we can tolerate a 2-hour maintenance window)
- Two 90-minute training cohorts for ops + analytics, plus ongoing office hours

Can you send a first draft MAP and include acceptance criteria, RACI, and a proposed schedule? Connor

--
Connor Ellis
Head of Product, PhoenixAI
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Connor Ellis <connor@phoenixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 13:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Execution manifesto & staged onboarding (MAP) — PhoenixAI

Connor —

Appreciate the clarity. I attached a working MAP (PhoenixAI_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and a concise canary checklist (canary-checklist.pdf) to this thread. High-level proposal:

Phase 0 — Prep (2 weeks): environment provisioning, service accounts, K8s node sizing, data access provisioning.
Phase 1 — Canary (2 weeks): 10% traffic, nightly syncs, daily health gating; rollback option after day 3 if error rate >1.5% or latency SLOs degrade.
Phase 2 — Gradual migration (3 days): bulk sync, incremental cutover windows (2-hour maintenance slot agreed by IT).
Phase 3 — Training & hypercare (2 weeks): two instructor-led cohorts + office hours.

Acceptance criteria (short): successful end-to-end smoke tests, <1% ESS errors under load, KV cache hit-rate >60% for core flows.

Requesting confirmation on the maintenance window (your team proposed 00:00–02:00 PT) and whether SOC2 evidence needs to be included in the MAP. We can shift the canary start by a week if you need more runway for audit prep.

Next step: sync Tuesday 4/16 10:00 PT to lock dates and owners.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
Attachments: PhoenixAI_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (workbook), canary-checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Execution manifesto & staged onboarding (MAP) — PhoenixAI

Connor / Alex —

Adding a few operational checkpoints from CS/Implementation perspective:
- RACI: Neha will run implementation, Marissa owns success criteria and post-go acceptance, Rishi will handle infra runbooks and escalation.
- Shadow environment: PhoenixAI needs read-only access to the shadow environment at least 5 business days before canary start for test ingestion. Please confirm the user/email list and SSO domain.
- Monitoring: We'll hand over a Grafana dashboard and tokenized alerting thresholds; recommend a 72-hour extended monitoring window after cutover.

I've attached a one-page training roster template (training-cohort-roster.csv) to capture attendee lists and required pre-reads.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Ellis <connor@phoenixai.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Execution manifesto & staged onboarding (MAP) — PhoenixAI

Team —

I reviewed PhoenixAI_MAP_v1.2 and updated Phase 0 tasks with owners and ETA. Key asks / constraints:
1) Can we confirm API key rotation window during migration? We need to avoid token churn during the canary.
2) Please provide list of three responsible contacts for the maintenance window; one must be available on-call.
3) Legal/procurement: I need the signed DPA clause regarding data retention (we will not keep raw logs beyond 30 days unless explicitly permitted). If Phoenix prefers 90 days, we will need a brief exception.

Proposed tentative schedule (subject to your confirmation):
- Phase 0: Apr 22–May 3 (provisioning and access)
- Canary: May 6–May 17 (10% traffic)
- Migration cutover: May 20–22 (staged, weekends preferred)
- Training cohort A: May 23, cohort B: May 28; hypercare through Jun 10

Connor — if procurement needs to adjust retention we should loop legal this week.

-Neha
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya@phoenixai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Ellis <connor@phoenixai.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 09:03:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Execution manifesto & staged onboarding (MAP) — PhoenixAI

Neha / Alex —

Thanks — couple of clarifications from our side:
- SOC2 audit window is May 9–11. We cannot start the canary during that period; request shifting the canary start from May 6 to May 13.
- Maintenance window OK at 00:00–02:00 PT but our DB team requests the ability to bump the slot by +/-1 hour on short notice; can you call that out as an approved variance?
- DPA: we have standard language that permits 90-day logs for debugging during initial migration. We will route the signed DPA to you by EOD Friday.

If canary shifts one week, downstream dates need to move accordingly. We are fine with the training dates being one week later as well.

Regards,
Priya Sharma
VP, IT Operations — PhoenixAI
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Connor Ellis <connor@phoenixai.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@phoenixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 14:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Execution manifesto & staged onboarding (MAP) — PhoenixAI

All —

Thanks for the quick inputs. Updated plan summary below (and I will push a refreshed PhoenixAI_MAP_v1.3 with date shifts and the DPA note once we receive Priya's signed copy):

- Phase 0 (Prep): Apr 22–May 3 — unchanged
- Canary: May 13–May 24 (shifted for SOC2)
- Migration cutover: May 27–29
- Training: cohort A Jun 1, cohort B Jun 6; hypercare through Jun 17

Operational notes accepted: 00:00–02:00 PT maintenance window with +/-1 hour variance. Retention exception to 90 days pending signed DPA (thanks Priya).

Next actions:
1) Phoenix: send signed DPA and finalized attendee list for training (use training-cohort-roster.csv).
2) Redwood (Neha): publish MAP v1.3 and updated canary-checklist by EOD 4/18.
3) Schedule the Tuesday 4/23 sync to finalize owners and runbooks — calendar invite to follow.

Locking this plan will let us prepare runbooks and automate the nightly syncs for the canary. If anyone sees a blocker, flag it here.

Best,
